reason: My doctor only said my magnesium could be low, so I'd get a blood test and pick up a $10 bottle at the drugstore if it's confirmed. $25 to $30 a month for fancy packaging is hard on my budget.
objection: I'm paying extra for single-serve foil sachets and a box, which is more trash, when the same magnesium comes in a regular bottle for a third of the price. I also don't buy supplements off a TikTok video.
would_change_my_mind: My doctor confirming I'm low and naming this exact kind of magnesium, with the price down near $12 to $15 a month.
